compatibilityApi.reason: TypeScript 7.0 has no programmatic API. Keep one TypeScript 6 compiler/API identity across every workspace package during the transition so governance tools and typechecks cannot resolve different compiler generations.

nativeCli.reason: Install the native TypeScript 7 compiler once at the Nexus workspace root for side-by-side diagnostic and performance comparison without replacing programmatic API consumers.

programmaticApiConsumers.role: repository lint and no-op source analysis

requires: Keep the exact installed compiler at TypeScript 5.9.3 while removing configuration constructs that TypeScript 6 deprecates and TypeScript 7 removes.
Do not silence migration debt with ignoreDeprecations.
Census every programmatic TypeScript API consumer before changing package identity.
Alias every listed workspace typescript dependency to @typescript/typescript6 and regenerate the exact Bun lockfile.
Run all API-consuming governance tools, typechecks, builds and focused tests under TypeScript 6.0.2.
Run TypeScript 6 with stableTypeOrdering for the explicit TypeScript 7 diagnostic-equivalence comparison; do not make stableTypeOrdering a permanent default solely for the migration.
Add @typescript/native at the workspace root as an npm alias to TypeScript 7 while keeping the typescript import identity on the TypeScript 6 compatibility API.
Run TypeScript 6 and TypeScript 7 typechecks independently on the same exact source and dependency lock.
Compare exit status and normalized diagnostics, then compare build/artifact/runtime evidence; measure wall time and memory separately from correctness.
Promote the TypeScript 7 CLI to the default project-wide typecheck only after equivalence evidence is green.
Keep programmatic tooling on the TypeScript 6 compatibility API; a faster CLI is not evidence that the old API can be removed.
Evaluate the TypeScript 7.1-or-later native API as a new API surface rather than assuming TypeScript 6 API compatibility.
Migrate each listed API consumer with focused semantic equivalence tests before deleting the TypeScript 6 compatibility package.
Remove the compatibility layer only when no repository or public projection imports the old TypeScript API.
